name: Blackrock Stronghold
summary: Dark Horde orcs hold the approaches to Blackrock Mountain from Blackrock Stronghold. Their fortified camp is a field garrison in the Burning Steppes.

sections.title: Garrison of the Dark Horde
sections.body: Blackrock Stronghold spreads across the scorched foothills below Blackrock Mountain. The Blackrock clan keeps its main base here in the Burning Steppes. These orcs cling to the old ways of war. They follow Rend Blackhand and the dragonkin lurking above in the spire, not Thrall's Horde.

sections.title: Front Line of Blackrock Spire
sections.body: Blackrock Stronghold guards the mountain's southern approaches. Its forces gather for attacks into the Redridge Mountains and neighboring human lands. The watch is constant, and anyone crossing the blasted wastes meets its challenge.

faq.answer: In the northern Burning Steppes, Blackrock Stronghold guards the approaches to Blackrock Mountain. The Blackrock orcs use it as an outer garrison.

faq.q: Are the orcs here friendly to Thrall's Horde?
faq.answer: No. The orcs at Blackrock Stronghold belong to the Dark Horde under Rend Blackhand. They reject Thrall's leadership and are hostile to both the Alliance and Thrall's Horde.

angles.text: For Thrall's Horde, the Blackrock clan recalls the shame of the Old Horde: bloodthirsty, corrupted remnants who reject honor and peace.
The stronghold recalls the Second War. It lies within striking distance of the Kingdom of Stormwind's northern borders.
